# Theme

Contents: [Presets](#presets), [Minimal brand theme](#minimal-brand-theme), [Targets](#targets), [Tokens](#tokens), [Errors](#errors), [Fonts](#fonts).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs from the boardplot describe, list and fixtures payloads. -->

The theme token contract. A spec takes theme as a preset name, as { preset, overrides } or as a full token object with its own name; defaults below are the standard preset.

## Presets

`boardroom`, `capital`, `studio`, `glass`, `standard`, `standard-dark`, `notation`, `notation-dark`

## Minimal brand theme

Pass it as the spec's `theme`. `overrides` changes only the tokens it names.

```json
{
  "preset": "standard",
  "overrides": { "color": { "highlight": "#0B5CAD", "series": ["#0B5CAD", "#5B8DB8", "#A9C1D9"] } }
}
```

## Targets

The render target replaces the six role sizes of a preset (`title`, `subtitle`, `label`, `axis`, `footnote`, `micro`) and their S and L steps before `overrides` apply, so a size `overrides` names wins. Families, weights, line heights and other tokens stay. A complete theme with its own `name`, registered or passed as a token object, keeps its sizes under every target. `typeForTarget(type, target)` from `boardplot/theme` returns its `type` with the target's sizes. [Sizing in the manual](../manual.md#sizing) lists the sizes per target.

## Tokens

Defaults are the `standard` preset.

Set it when color.good is a light accent that glows as a full fill, typically on a dark ground. |

Held to the mark floor on the background, 3:1 as a line (mark-ink-invisible). |
| color.heatTop | string |  |  |  | The top band of a stepped table heat lane (surface.heatSteps). Absent means color.markInk, then color.ink. A dark theme whose full ink glares as a cell sets a quieter band here, and color.heatTopInk for its figures. In dark it also caps how far centered-funnel stage shading brightens; a stage colour already at or above it fades toward the background instead. |
| color.heatTopInk | string |  |  |  | The figures on a stepped heat lane's top band. Absent means color.inkInverse. Once either role is set, the pair is held to 3:1 (contrast-inside-label). |
| color.onFillInk | string |  |  |  | The dark fallback ink for text on a fill where neither color.ink nor color.inkInverse reaches 4.5:1, a mid-tone heat band or chip. Absent means '#050505'. With color.onFillLightInk it must stand 20.25:1 apart, so one of the two reaches 4.5:1 on every fill; a pair that cannot is warned as ink-on-fill, with the fill relative-luminance band where neither reaches it. |
| color.onFillLightInk | string |  |  |  | The light fallback ink for text on such a fill, paired with color.onFillInk. Absent means '#FFFFFF'. |

Absent means color.neutral. Held to the series floor on the background (series-invisible). A theme whose neutral is a band or surface tint sets a mark-strength grey here; bands, zebras, washes and no-data grounds keep color.neutral. |
| color.highlight | string | yes |  | `'#10529E'` | The single accent, with one meaning: the focus the author asked for. It paints what options.highlight selects, an annotation or callout, a colorRole 'highlight', and the larger marks listed under color.focus, unless color.focus is set. It also keeps a few point accents: the latest-point ring, a highlight reference tick, the last point or column of a spark, and map glyphs. Without an authored focus no chart paints it on a lead mark: series 1 leads. One accent per theme. |
| color.focus | string |  |  |  | What options.highlight selects: the highlighted bar, column, dot, slice, box, step, point or line, and the swatch beside its label. It also takes every mark larger than a point that would fall back to color.highlight: a line, area, bar, column, slice, cell, gantt item or scatter and dot group whose colorRole is 'highlight' (one other plain series then recedes to the neutral mark, and plain lines and slopes step back to their grey ladder), a diagram node, lane or badge whose role is 'accent', the in-cell bar, the gantt elapsed wash, and status cells, zones and phases whose tone is highlight or info. It also washes a kpi area spark, whose last point keeps color.highlight. Without an authored focus the lead mark takes series 1: the combo lead line takes the rank after the columns, a pareto's vital few take series 1 and the rest recede, a butterfly's or pyramid's second side, a dumbbell's second dots, a single-series funnel and a tornado's high case without casePair take series 1, linear-process step badges take the neutral mark, and the pie, heatmap ladder, ramp and Harvey fills, and the cohort, choropleth, tilemap and table heat ramps are tints of series 1. Absent means color.highlight. Set it apart when the accent is kept for a single mark, such as the latest-point ring or a reference tick, and the selected marks should take another colour, often the ink. A line's emphasis: 'first' hero takes the ink either way. |

Absent means color.neutralMark, then color.neutral. color.neutral is a fill, and a pale one draws a faint line: point the spark at the ink then. A column spark's columns take color.neutralMark, the last point keeps color.highlight, and the standalone sparkline type draws its line in the ink. |

Set, every bar and likert row is pitch px tall, or as tall as its label if that is taller, and a canvas taller than the chart never stretches the rows: the chart lays out at its natural height, draws at the top and leaves the rest of the canvas empty, as a content-fit chart sits at the top of its box. A host that wants the air elsewhere lays the chart out at its natural height (fit: 'content') and places it. An authored options.bandFraction still sets the bar's share of the row. |

| legend.auto | boolean |  |  |  | Automatic legend keys for series without visible names. Absent or false keeps the shipped defaults. |

| marks.lineMarkers | string |  | `'auto'`, `'none'` |  | Default point markers on line series. 'auto' (the default) draws a circle per point up to 12 categories on a line chart and on every combo line; 'none' draws none. A partial period keeps its hollow marker and a bump chart its identity shapes; the latest-point ring is not a marker and stays. |
| marks.areaTint | number |  |  |  | A single unstacked area (variant 'area', one series, no authored fill, colorRole, palette or PY/PL scenario): the tint amount of color.focus toward the background, 0 to 1 (0.86 = 14 % focus), under a stroke.data line in color.ink. The forecast region keeps its hatch in the full focus. Absent fills the area in its series colour under a 2 px line. |
| marks.nodeRadius | number |  |  |  | Corner radius in px of a diagram node drawn as a rounded rectangle, and of a group frame (0 to 16). Absent uses surface.chipRadius for nodes and group frames; 0 draws square corners. A node shape.radius wins. |
| marks.nodeStroke | string |  | `'axis'`, `'grid'`, `'leader'`, `'ink'`, `'inkMuted'` |  | The colour role of a diagram node's ring: axis, grid, leader, ink or inkMuted. Absent keeps axis, and grid on a muted node. |
| marks.nodeStrokeWidth | number |  |  |  | Width in px of a diagram node ring and a group frame (0 to 3). Absent uses stroke.hair. |
| marks.restOutline | boolean |  |  |  | false draws the marks that recede under a highlight (color.rest) without the separation outline marks.contrastEdge: true adds to a fill too close to the background. Absent means true. |
| marks.areaFromOrigin | boolean |  |  |  | true places the first and last category of an area chart (line variants area, stacked-area, stacked100-area) on the plot edges, so the bands start at the value axis; an authored categoryAxis.crossesBetween wins. Absent keeps the categories centred in their bands. |
| marks.barLabels | string |  | `'auto'`, `'outside'` |  | 'outside' places a bar chart's value label past the bar end, or drops it (a label-hidden lint) where no room is left there; never inside the bar or in a backed box. On grouped bars that cross zero, a negative value reads right of the zero line, where the positive values start, so the negative side holds only its bars; with no value axis drawn, the domain is the extent plus the label room rather than a rounded one. Absent keeps the cascade: inside the end where it fits, else outside, else inside on a backing. |
| marks.comboColumnTint | number |  |  |  | A combo's column series with no authored fill, colorRole or palette fill their actual columns in color.focus at this tint amount toward the background, 0 to 1 (0.74 = 26 % focus). Stacked series take a ramp of it: the top series the tint, the ones below stepping down the stacked-area ramp, capped at the full focus (26 / 45 / 70 / 100 % from the top at 0.74). The scenario look wins: a plan outline and a forecast hatch draw in the full focus, and a prior year keeps its scenario colour. A washed column takes no separation outline in any scheme: the tint is the theme's choice. Absent keeps the series colour. |
| marks.comboLine | string |  | `'series'`, `'ink'` |  | 'ink' draws a combo's lead line, when it has no authored fill, colorRole, highlight or palette, in color.ink at 1.5 px with the latest-point ring in color.highlight on its last observed point, never on a forecast one; its page-colour casing is a half-pixel hairline each side, not a second stroke. Absent keeps the focus at 2 px on a 1.5 px casing. |
| marks.sparkEnd | string |  | `'dot'`, `'ring'` |  | The last point of a kpi card's spark, a table spark and a creative trend: 'ring' draws the standalone sparkline's ring, the background with a 1.5 px ring in color.highlight at radius 3.2. Absent keeps 'dot', a filled point in the highlight. |
| marks.sparkEndLabel | boolean |  |  |  | false draws a kpi card's spark without the value label at its last point, which repeats the card's own figure; the line then runs the full width. A table spark keeps its label, since its row carries no figure. Absent means true. |
| marks.sliceOutline | boolean |  |  |  | false draws a pie or doughnut slice whose fill is too close to the background with the page-colour separator only, without the separation outline marks.contrastEdge: true adds. Absent means true. |
| marks.othersOutline | boolean |  |  |  | false draws an Others mark (the topN Others bucket of a bar, column, pie or butterfly chart, and a series or slice whose colorRole is 'others' in a stacked column, bar or area, a mekko, a combo or a funnel) whose fill is too close to the background without the separation outline marks.contrastEdge: true adds. Absent means true. Waffle rest cells use a floor-clearing fill instead and ignore it. |
| marks.contrastEdge | boolean |  |  |  | true draws the contrast edges round fills (WCAG 1.4.11). On a light page a fill under 3:1 against the page that no value label carries takes an edge in a deeper shade of its own hue, and a pale stack-ramp step a neutral hair outline. On a light or dark page a fill under the page floor (1.4:1 light, 3:1 dark: an Others, rest, pale slice or pale segment mark, and its key swatch) takes a separation outline; marks.restOutline, marks.othersOutline and marks.sliceOutline then apply. It also lets the palest pie tint and a faded series go past 1.4:1 against the page, as the outline then carries them. Absent means false: no fill on a light or dark page draws a contrast edge or outline. Segment seams, hollow, hatched and dashed marks, and a mark that crosses another fill are unchanged either way. |
| marks.nodeFill | string |  | `'role'`, `'panel'` |  | 'panel' draws every diagram node of the primary, secondary or muted role on the background with its ring (marks.nodeStroke), so the accent node is the one filled node. Signed, warn and category nodes keep their fills. Absent keeps 'role': primary in the first series colour, secondary and muted in color.neutralLight. |
| marks.kpiCaret | boolean |  |  |  | false draws a kpi card's delta and comparisons without the leading caret; the signed figure and its tone carry the direction ("+10.4% vs PY"). Absent means true. |
| marks.bridge | string |  | `'neutral'`, `'sign'` |  | How a waterfall (vertical or horizontal) and a pvm bridge paint their steps. 'sign' draws the totals in color.total (ink when a theme leaves it unset), a rising step in color.goodFill and a falling one in color.badFill, the connectors dotted at 1 px in color.inkMeta, and each step's signed value beside its bar in color.good or color.bad (inside a bar it keeps the contrast ink). A step split into authored segments keeps its segment colours and key; a highlight still selects a total, while a step's colour stays its sign. 'neutral' draws the steps in color.neutral, totals in color.total, dashed color.leader connectors. Absent, the steps take their sign's fill (the waterfall's signColor) on dashed leader connectors, unless the spec names a palette. |
| marks.funnelFill | string |  | `'status'`, `'ramp'` |  | How a funnel (rows or centered) fills its bars. 'ramp': a single series takes color.series by stage, stage 1 the first colour; an outcome split takes it by series; the lost share, a series whose colorRole is 'status-lost' or 'bad', is color.badFill at 45 % over the background. Status colours never reach the bars, so a status map that borrows a text colour cannot fill a stage. An authored series fill wins. Absent means 'status': a colorRole resolves through the theme and a single series takes color.focus. |

At 1 both grounds are the full neutral and the total no longer reads as the heavier of the two. |

| table.mark | string |  | `'bare'`, `'boxed'` | `'bare'` | Outline mark: bare or boxed. Every preset sets bare; absent in a custom theme, steering tables draw boxed. |
| table.dataGap | string |  | `'word'`, `'glyph'` |  | What a value the data lacks prints, such as a month not yet reported: 'word' the n/a word ('k. A.' in German), 'glyph' the missing glyph. Absent means 'glyph' where table.glyphs.missing is set (every preset sets it), else 'word'. A cohort grid and nulls: 'blank' keep their own mark. |
| table.rows | object |  |  |  | Body rows on one face, on the SVG and in the grid: every rung prints at the label size with this line height and air, so a deep row is as tall as a top one. The ladder then steps weight and indent only. Absent keeps the level ladder. |
| table.rows.lineHeight | number |  |  |  | Line height as a ratio of the size. Both surfaces reserve a whole-pixel line box, ceil(size x ratio): 10.5 x 1.33 gives 14. |
| table.rows.pad | number |  |  |  | Air above and below a body row's line box in px (0 to 16). |
| table.weights | object |  |  | `{"emphasis":600}` | Label and figure weights by row kind, plus block-column figures and change lines. Absent keys keep the current face. |
| table.weights.emphasis | number |  |  | `600` | Weight of totals, subtotals, results and parent rows, on labels and figures (100 to 1000). Default 600 in every shipped preset; absent in a custom theme, the type.emphasis weight. |
| table.weights.subtotal | number |  |  |  | Subtotal label weight. Default table.weights.emphasis. |
| table.weights.result | number |  |  |  | Result label weight. Default table.weights.emphasis. |
| table.weights.block | number |  |  |  | Strong block-column figure weight. Default table.weights.emphasis. |
| table.weights.change | number |  |  |  | Deprecated: accepted and ignored in this release; refused in the next. Remove this key. An authored key warns option-deprecated with removal guidance. |
| table.weights.figures | object |  |  |  | Figure weights per presentation kind. |
| table.weights.figures.member | number |  |  |  | Member figure weight. Default 400 on a leaf and table.weights.emphasis on a parent. |
| table.weights.figures.measure | number |  |  |  | Measure figure weight. Default 400 on a leaf and table.weights.emphasis on a parent. |
| table.weights.figures.subtotal | number |  |  |  | Subtotal figure weight. Default table.weights.emphasis. |
| table.weights.figures.result | number |  |  |  | Result figure weight. Default table.weights.emphasis. |
| table.weights.member | number |  |  |  | Label weight of a member row, such as a channel (100 to 1000). Default 400 on a leaf and table.weights.emphasis on a parent. |
| table.weights.measure | number |  |  |  | Label weight of a measure row, such as a KPI (100 to 1000). Default 400 on a leaf and table.weights.emphasis on a parent. |
| table.tones | string |  | `'ink'`, `'fill'` |  | How a judged cell prints its tone. 'ink' (default) colours the figure; 'fill' paints the cell ground in table.grounds and keeps the figure in the text ink, so colour sits only where performance is judged. |
| table.grounds | object |  |  | `{"total":"transparent"}` | Grounds a 'fill' tone paints. An absent key washes its tone toward the background. |
| table.grounds.subtotal | string |  |  |  | Subtotal row ground. Default none; transparent means no fill. |
| table.grounds.total | string |  |  | `'transparent'` | Total row ground. Every preset sets transparent: no fill, the total rule and weight mark the total. Absent in a custom theme, twice the band tint. |
| table.grounds.good | string |  |  |  | Ground of a good judgment. Transparent means no fill. |
| table.grounds.goodStrong | string |  |  |  | Ground of a good judgment past its strong threshold (a cell with strong: true). Transparent means no fill. |
| table.grounds.warn | string |  |  |  | Ground of a watch judgment. Transparent means no fill. |
| table.grounds.bad | string |  |  |  | Ground of a bad judgment. Transparent means no fill. |
| table.bar | object |  |  |  | Grounds of a size bar, the bar a cell with bar draws from its left edge. |
| table.bar.fill | string |  |  |  | Ground of a size bar. Boardroom #D6E3F0, standard-dark #22384D; absent, the ink washed far toward the background. Transparent means no fill. |
| table.bar.muted | string |  |  |  | Ground of a size bar in a muted column, such as a partial period. Absent, a paler wash. Transparent means no fill. |
| table.inks | object |  |  |  | Table text colours. Each role accepts a CSS colour. |
| table.inks.head | string |  |  |  | Column-head and group-heading ink of the table family (table, dimswitch, cohort, bar table, status, heatmap), on the SVG and in the React grid. A group note takes table.inks.secondary. A highlighted head keeps its own ink. Default color.ink. |
| table.inks.subLabel | string |  |  |  | Header second-line ink. Default color.ink. |
| table.inks.label | string |  |  |  | Row label ink. Default color.ink. |
| table.inks.child | string |  |  |  | Detail and split label ink. Default color.ink. |
| table.inks.figure | string |  |  |  | Value figure ink. Default color.ink. |
| table.inks.qualifier | string |  |  |  | Unit affix ink. Default table.inks.secondary. |
| table.inks.operator | string |  |  |  | Statement operator ink. Default table.inks.secondary. |
| table.inks.driver | string |  |  |  | Driver label, figure and change ink. A good, warn or bad figure of a driver that options.driverTones allows (grouped by default: a driver under a line) keeps its tone, and a neutral figure and the label keep this ink. Default table.inks.secondary. |
| table.inks.toggle | string |  |  |  | Fold toggle ink: the +/- mark, and the box under mark boxed. Default table.inks.secondary. |
| table.inks.secondary | string |  |  |  | The one table ink that steps back behind a value: change lines, unit affixes, group notes, cell notes and hints, state glyphs, zero figures, muted columns and the fold toggle. On the SVG and in the grid. Boardroom #305B86, standard-dark #9EC3E2; absent, color.inkMuted. |
| table.ruleInk | string |  |  |  | The quiet table rule, on the SVG and in the grid: row rules, the column-group rule and the column dividers. Boardroom #C3D3E3, standard-dark #344B60; absent, 25% of color.ink mixed into the background. |
| table.ruleWidths | object |  |  | `{"head":1,"row":1}` | Table rule widths in px. |
| table.ruleWidths.head | number |  |  | `1` | Head rule width in px. Default 1. |
| table.ruleWidths.row | number |  |  | `1` | Row rule width in px, in table.ruleInk. Default 1 in every preset; absent in a custom theme, the hair stroke (0.75). |
| table.qualifier | object |  |  |  | Unit affix size and gap. |
| table.qualifier.sizeDelta | number |  |  |  | Size change from the label in px. Default -2. |
| table.qualifier.gap | number |  |  |  | Gap after the label in px. Default 4. |
| table.toggle | object |  |  |  | Fold toggle dimensions. |
| table.toggle.size | number |  |  |  | Box size in px. Default 11. |
| table.toggle.gap | number |  |  |  | Offset before the label in px. Default 17. |
| table.operator | object |  |  |  | Statement operator slot. |
| table.operator.width | number |  |  |  | Slot width in px. Default 14. Present only when a drawn row has a glyph. |
| table.resultRule | string |  | `'ink'`, `'rule'`, `'none'` |  | Rule above a result: ink (default), rule or none. |
| table.finalRule | string |  | `'double'`, `'rule'`, `'none'` |  | Rule under a final result: double (default), rule or none. Double is two 1 px lines with 1 px air. |
| table.driver | object |  |  |  | Driver row face. |
| table.driver.italic | boolean |  |  |  | Italic driver labels, figures and changes. Default true. Width measurement uses upright metrics. |
| table.headRule | string |  | `'rule'`, `'ink'` |  | The line under the column heads, and under a section heading whose table.section.rule is 'hair': 'rule' (default) in the rule ink, 'ink' in the text ink. |
| table.blockRule | string |  | `'grid'`, `'rule'` | `'rule'` | 'rule' draws a 1 px line above an open top-level parent, and above the first top-level row after its block, in the rule ink, on the SVG and in the grid, so an open block reads as one. Column dividers keep table.ruleInk. 'grid' keeps the row rule there. Every preset sets 'rule'; absent in a custom theme, 'grid'. |
| table.endRule | string |  | `'auto'`, `'none'` | `'none'` | The vertical hairline that closes the rows on the right, on the SVG and in the grid. 'auto' draws it on every table but a cohort grid, after the last column under rowExtent 'tracks' and at the frame edge under 'frame'; 'none' draws it on neither surface, for a host card whose own edge closes the rows. Absent means 'auto'. |
| table.closeRule | string |  | `'rule'`, `'grid'`, `'none'` |  | The rule under the last body row, on the SVG and in the grid. 'rule' draws it in the rule ink, 'grid' in the row-rule ink (table.ruleInk), 'none' draws none. Absent means 'rule'. A table that ends on its total keeps the total's own rule under it, and the total's other rules stay. |

## Errors

| Code | Raised when |
|---|---|
| unknown-theme | the preset name is not registered |
| invalid-theme | a token is unknown or has the wrong type |
| invalid-theme-override | overrides produce a structurally invalid theme |
| theme-name-reserved | a full theme object uses a preset name |
| unparseable-color | a colour is unsupported; use hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch() or var() with a literal fallback |
| contrast-ink | ink on background is below 4.5:1 |
| contrast-ink-muted | inkMuted on background is below 3:1 |
| contrast-inside-label | a label inside a fill is below its contrast floor |
| semantic-equals-background | good, bad or highlight equals the background |
| good-bad-similar | good and bad are nearly identical |
| family-outside-metric-class | warning: the leading family of a type stack is not Inter, Geist, Helvetica, Helvetica Neue, Arial or a metric clone, so text can render wider than measured; pass tables built by `boardplot fonts build`, see docs/FONTS.md |

An unknown key, such as the retired `space.barGap`, comes with a suggest that names it and a JSON Patch that removes it. The CLI, the MCP tools, React and `parseThemeJson` from `boardplot/validate` give the same suggest and patch; `parseThemeJson` throws it as an `invalid-theme` error whose patch paths start at the theme file.

A resolved theme is FROZEN, all the way down. `resolveTheme`, the `theme` on a resolved request and the one a React component reads are the same deeply frozen object, so a write to one throws where it is written instead of changing a theme the engine has already judged and cached. A variant is a new object: spread the resolved theme, or pass `overrides` and let the engine merge and check them.

## Fonts

Layout measures text with bundled width tables for Geist, Inter, Helvetica, Helvetica Neue, Arial and their metric clones. Helvetica Neue is measured with the Liberation Sans widths of Helvetica; a host that needs exact Helvetica Neue widths builds its own tables with `boardplot fonts build`. Another leading family returns the warning `family-outside-metric-class`, a licensed brand font included. [FONTS.md](../FONTS.md) describes `boardplot fonts build`, which writes the tables for a licensed font.
